action.text: Task: Fix summary_graph.py so collection_stale is true when (a) any artifact summary is stale, (b) current artifact-summary IDs differ from graph IDs, or (c) collection's input IDs differ. Also fix missing_artifact_ids to list summary artifacts lacking an address map. Current candidate: 476f83a90c40b0897e1ab5d6bc00bbb52cf3a4fe60cc11c1dd47ab3da85d0172. Already read summary_graph.py (148 lines). Identified bugs: 1) collection_stale uses 'and' instead of 'or' for the first two conditions; 2) collection input check compares against graph_summary_ids instead of current_summary_ids; 3) missing_artifact_ids iterates address_maps instead of summaries (reversed logic).
